title: Musk-Ambani Clash Over Starlink's India Entry; India Denies Blocking Competition
detail: Elon Musk publicly clashed with Mukesh Ambani over Starlink's entry into India, accusing Ambani-linked telecom interests of lobbying to block the satellite internet service. India's government denied allegations of blocking Ambani or Adani-linked firms from competing with Starlink, insisting the regulatory process is fair and open.

media.caption: India denies blocking Ambani-linked telecom interests from competing with Starlink
